propositions: Snapshot tests on macOS fail at pytest basetemp cleanup when read-only .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots cannot be removed via shutil.rmtree
Production snapshot publication applies 0444/0555 permissions via _chmod_readonly, blocking removal by module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py only
Snapshot producers in other modules leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots trees under pytest tmp_path because shared conftest.py lacks cleanup ownership
Shared pytest teardown fixture must search each test-owned tmp_path for exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots and reuse snapshot._rmtree_writable to restore removability
Cross-module snapshot oracle demonstrates the defect: nested pytest exits 0 after creating read-only snapshot, then ordinary shutil.rmtree raises PermissionError on residual cache entry
